reply.emotion: peaceful and surrounded by greenery, breathing in the fresh air
notes: 숲 refers to a large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth, while 나무 means an individual tree. When describing a dense and large forest, you can use the expression 빽빽한 숲.

senses.definition: A large area of land covered with trees and plants.

examples.text: 주말마다 가족과 함께 숲으로 산책을 갑니다.
examples.translation: I go for a walk in the forest with my family every weekend.
examples.emotion: calm and happy, looking forward to a relaxing weekend walk

definitions: A large area of land covered with trees and plants.
